digest.component_or_area: workflow gates (plan review and completion verification)
propositions: Ticket descriptions exceeding a configurable maximum (default 8,000 characters) must block plan review with coverage.llm_ran=false before any LLM call
Completion verification must return a deterministic FAIL with zero runner calls when the authoritative ticket description exceeds the configured maximum at admission time
Plan review light-bug-tier processing must partition DET blocks to retain only a blocking P4 description finding while downgrading other DET blocks to advisory
AC-count and file-impact P4 signals remain advisory; P4 emits at most one oversize finding when multiple size signals are present
Descriptions of exactly 8,000 characters are admitted; descriptions of 8,001 or more characters are rejected at both gates without truncation or summarization
